event_model: Every named event occurs exactly once; all orderings enumerated.
acceptance: All one-erasure cases with parity recover the exact history uniquely.
Plain complete pairwise memory remains vulnerable to erasing a comparison of adjacent events.
Ordinary library with identical parity algorithm ties on all one-erasure cases.
At least one two-erasure case remains ambiguous; such histories are not removed.
One parity detects all one-bit substitutions but is not claimed to correct them.
exclusions: No material dynamics or fabrication demonstration
No evidence of prospective market foresight
No human-expert or ordinary frontier-model discovery comparison
procedural_boundary: The n=4 exploratory result and general parity theorem were known before freezing. Sizes five and six were selected before executing their enumeration. These are new implementation checks of a known theorem, not hidden tests or unexpected scientific predictions.
